description:
Use Firefox DevTools Network panel to perform a performance audit of 5 websites: news.ycombinator.com, en.wikipedia.org, developer.mozilla.org, www.python.org, and docs.github.com. 

For each site:
1. Open the Network panel.
2. Load the page completely.
3. Export the network data as a HAR file to '~/Documents/har_exports/'. You need at least 3 HAR files total.

Finally, create a performance summary report at '~/Documents/performance_report.json' with the following structure for all 5 sites:
{
  "news.ycombinator.com": {
    "total_requests": <int>,
    "total_transfer_size_kb": <float>,
    "js_requests": <int>,
    "css_requests": <int>,
    "image_requests": <int>,
    "largest_resource_url": "..."
  },
  ... (other sites)
}
